968732.name: Chabad of Downtown East
968732.note: Chabadinfo.com, July 5 2015 ('An "Island of Spirituality" in L.A.'s Fashion District'): Avraham Zakaria 'said that when Levin first started offering prayer services a decade ago, they'd spend an hour a day on the phone trying to pull together enough people for a minyan', so about 2005. Jewish Journal, Aug 1 2012 ('Rebbe on the go', https://jewishjournal.com/mobile_20111212/106744/): 'A few years ago, Levin convinced the Jewish owner of the business that Jews who worked in the neighborhood needed a holy place ... Thus, the "forklift shul" was born', the shul at 1500 Griffith Ave. Counted back and only roughly, so medium (the listing number points to about 2009, the forklift shul's time).

earlier.where: prayer services elsewhere in the downtown garment and fashion district, before the 'forklift shul' in a business at 1500 Griffith Ave

589719.name: Chabad of Downtown Los Angeles
589719.note: Jewish Journal, Aug 1 2012 (David Suissa, 'Rebbe on the go'): 'Greenwald came here five years ago with the dream of catering to the Jews who live and work in the area. He opened a full-time synagogue and learning center in the building where he now lives, formally called the Jewish Community Center Chabad of Downtown Los Angeles', so about 2007 (therebbesimpact.com and the listing number agree). Counted back, so medium.
